content: Workers free plan: 50 external subrequests per invocation (1000 to CF services), 100k requests/day, 10ms CPU/invocation. DOs do NOT need waitUntil: DO stays active while pending I/O exists (ctx.waitUntil docs explicitly warn not to use it to keep DO alive); outbound fetch after response just needs the promise kept alive. Output gates: storage writes complete before outgoing fetches delivered.
